objective.title: Preserve concrete surgery evidence through the topology consumer
objective.statement: Introduce a nonvacuous topology extraction route whose input retains the actual grounded Perelman surgery construction and its matching decomposition/trace data, with checked assembly to the canonical target. Keep existing frozen targets and legacy APIs intact. Split the new statement interface from its proof implementation as a measured compilation pilot. The hard geometric covering-construction obligation must remain explicit; no assumption may be relabeled as a proof.
deliverables: Preserve concrete surgery evidence through the topology consumer

stop_conditions: Stop at the stated file scope; report exact resisting types and preserved compiler failures if blocked.
No service operations, full builds, merges, task acceptance, or final-target claim.
